POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.

2. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards

7. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.

9. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
